neighbours.label: the token ' link(s)' meaning one connecting element of a chain or series (a key link, the weakest links, a link between two bodies)
fire: The port became a vital link in the supply chain that fed the whole region.
Investigators say the courier was the missing link between the two gangs.
Every crew knows that a team is only as strong as its weakest links.
The new railway forms a direct link between the capital and the coast.
She described the ambassador as a trusted link between the two governments.
Each enzyme is one link in a long metabolic chain of reactions.
Fossils from the site may provide a link between fish and early amphibians.
If one link breaks, the bracelet falls off your wrist.
